sources.observed: Starter $30/month; $5 one-time credit; Signals $0.05/input Mtok, $0.01/cached Mtok, $0.30/output Mtok; calculator estimates use measured median flow-1 costs and actual billing can differ.

Cloud uses its own flow-1 model and bills every triggered/backfill run by internal input, cached-input, and output tokens. Quoted $3.50 per 1000 traces of 100000 trace tokens is an average, not exact sample billing.
Primary product announcement explicitly states all three token rates and that analysis cost includes the full Signals-agent run and retrieval steps.
